scientific limitations/integrity.integrity: Analytic proof of the new degradation statement; deterministic finite computations are supplementary checks only.
limitations: Pure two-qubit states and binary rank-one projective measurements only.
The cone is exact for the same-measurement binary-degradation mechanism, not claimed necessary for the mutual-information inequality itself.
The full nonmaximally-entangled two-vs-two conjecture remains open outside the stated sector.

title: A state-dependent degradation cone for the two-vs-two qubit correlation tradeoff
